payload.unit_title: R21 Major Project Frontend Workspace Layout & UI Modernization (M2.2)
payload.objective: Perform a read-only architectural analysis of the R21 Major Project frontend workspace migration and produce an implementation-ready decomposition that preserves CampusLynk existing design system while replacing the legacy 2,611-line monolithic workspace.
payload.explicit_request: Review the read-only architectural analysis for task 'M2.2-ANALYZE-001'. Confirm whether the decomposition, design system compliance, component mappings, and two-slice implementation plan are approved, and issue TASK_DISPATCH for Slice 1 (M2.2-IMPLEMENT-001). Return decision: 'TASK_DISPATCH' with payload.task_dispatch.

task_report.summary: Read-only architectural analysis completed for M2.2. Legacy 2,611-line view mapped into 7 functional tabs and 6 modals. 100% mapped to existing <x-ui.*> components and <x-layouts.workspace-layout>. Decomposed into 11 modular Blade files, all under 500 lines. All 11 AJAX endpoints reconciled against M2.1. Proposed 2-slice implementation plan with Slice 1 (M2.2-IMPLEMENT-001) as first concrete task.

tests.regressions: Zero changes made to application code or database

payload.reason: The M2.2-ANALYZE-001 report is architecturally sufficient to authorize the first implementation slice. The legacy 2,611-line workspace has been decomposed into seven functional tabs and six modal workflows, with the proposed target structure keeping every Blade artifact below the 500-line decomposition threshold. The analysis reconciles all identified workspace AJAX behavior against the completed M2.1 backend contract and explicitly identifies the remaining interactive work for Slice 2 rather than expanding Slice 1 scope. The proposed workspace correctly uses x-layouts.workspace-layout, while tables, modals, cards, tabs, buttons, inputs, selects, badges, and icons are mapped to existing x-ui.* components. The analysis also preserves the anti-duplication mandate and explicitly rejects copying the legacy monolith or introducing duplicate CSS/UI infrastructure. Slice 1 is therefore appropriately limited to the master shell and modular Blade structure, leaving modal behavior and AJAX wiring to the separately verifiable Slice 2. The read-only analysis reports no unresolved blocker requiring architectural replanning. M2.2 is approved to proceed with M2.2-IMPLEMENT-001.
